title: HC-DTO: Human-Centric Digital Twin Orchestration for Industrial Cyber-Physical Systems
description: Seeded discrete-event simulator of digital twin orchestration for industrial cyber-physical systems, treated as an information-integration problem. It includes the base experiment grid (scalability, workload, node failures, ablation, operator proficiency), multi-objective non-dominance analysis with paired 95% confidence intervals, and the information-integration experiments: exact Shapley attribution of placement performance to four integrated information streams (twin queue state, energy model, outcome history, operator familiarity) and the freshness analysis of twin queue state (snapshot and dead-reckoning twins with several dispatchers). Raw per-trial results, summary tables, a Colab notebook, and scripts that regenerate every figure and table are included.
